_note: Cryostat catalog. Stage cooling power follows Q = a*(T^alpha - Tbase^alpha), anchored at (t_ref_k, cap_ref_w). cable_len_mm is the cable run from the next-warmer stage (room temperature for the first). wall_power_w is the electrical draw of ONE unit and is an assumption (compressors + pumps + control), not a datasheet value. 'wall_power_w' is the electrical input of ONE unit at the system boundary (compressors, pumps, control rack); it does NOT include the facility's chilled-water plant that removes the compressors' rejected heat (that is part of the facility PUE). 'wall_scale_by_profile' multiplies wall_power_w for scenario profiles (cryocooler efficiency gains), assumption. Platforms for the mid-2030s ('dilution_2035') are SCENARIOS anchored to published product data where stated. dilution_xld.label: Dry dilution refrigerator (XLD400-class)
dilution_xld.source: Stage temperatures, cooling powers and cable lengths: Krinner et al., EPJ Quantum Technol. 6, 2 (2019), Table 1 (measured, Bluefors XLD400). wall_power_w and max_coax_lines: assumption.

pt_4k.label: Two-stage pulse-tube cryocooler (4 K class)
pt_4k.source: Stage values as the XLD's 50 K / 4 K stages (same pulse-tube class). wall_power_w and max_coax_lines: assumption.

ambient.label: No cryostat (room-temperature apparatus)
ambient.source: Trapped-ion and neutral-atom systems in UHV chambers at ~300 K (definition, no cryostat; nothing to source).

dilution_2035.label: Large-format multi-unit dilution platform (Bluefors KIDE class), 2035 scenario
dilution_2035.source: Anchors: Bluefors KIDE page (read in this audit): over 1,000 qubits, more than 4,000 RF lines, 500 kg payload, three cooling units, '> 3000 uW of cooling power at 100 mK', cooling power measured from the insert flange, nine pulse-tube cryocoolers (via search); an arXiv modelling paper (2608.00990) assigns KIDE about 6 W at 4 K (not verified; page too large to fetch). Stage curves here are the measured XLD400 curves of Krinner et al. 2019 scaled by (50 K 4x, 4 K 4x, Still 3x, CP 7x, MXC 3x): ASSUMPTION chosen to match 6 W at 4 K and roughly the KIDE 100 mK figure. wall_power_w 30 kW (about 4-5 kW per watt at 4 K, nine pulse tubes plus three dilution circuits) and its profile scaling: ASSUMPTION; no vendor power figure was found. Fermilab 'Colossus'-class platforms were not found in this audit and are not modelled.

cryo_cabinet_4k.label: Cryo cabinet for superconducting nanowire detectors (about 4 K), rack-style
cryo_cabinet_4k.source: PsiQuantum describes 'cryogenic cabinets' analogous to datacenter racks instead of dilution refrigerators (PsiQuantum Omega announcement, 2025; one search snippet mentions 'cooling power per cabinet ~30 W' without a temperature, not used). 5 W at 4.2 K for 18 kW (3,600 W/W, a typical cryocooler-class figure) and the 20,000-fibre/line capacity: ASSUMPTION.
